scope: Frozen-window cross-pitch audible release measurements for factory Sine99 carrierRKS0, with no DSP-law fit.

protocol.status: Frozen before fitting the requested cross-pitch slope windows
protocol.estimator: Reproduce finalized forensic source: joint constant +sine8 +cosine8 at nominal equal-tempered frequencies, no linear trend, Hann applied to signal and basis (squared-Hann objective),20/40/60ms windows and2ms hops. Same absolute center and basis convention, no frequency/timing/model fit.
protocol.stereo_pair: Per-partial sqrt((leftAmplitude^2+rightAmplitude^2)/2) after independent channel LS. Pair residualRMS similarly averages channel residual powers. This removes mid-channel cancellation but does not recover the dry carrier or remove Chorus gain changes.
protocol.slope_fit: Unweighted ordinary least-squares of amplitude dBFS versus fixed absolute center times within every declared window; all frames retained. Report slope,R2,residualRMSE,endpoint-level ranges, no independent-error confidence claims from overlapping windows.

differences.role: Primary pitch contrast frozen from prior qualitative observation.

protocol.robustness_check: For87-versus79, test whether87 is steeper in every fixed slow window at all three tapers in bothmid andpair (18cells). Report every failure and exact range of slope differences. Also report fixed early-window consistency separately (12cells). A surviving sign challenges a pitch-independent audible decay assumption but does not identify RKS law or exclude Reverb/capture frequency dependence. No RKS parameter fitted.

limitations: One reused recording, no effects-off or independent direct-output holdout.

Individual L/R amplitudes vary strongly with Chorus; composites do not reconstruct the dry core.

Bass has only1.56 cycles in20ms taper and large short-window ripple.
